Stage: L4 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
Ancora.AppendOnly (surgery to two guards: append/requirement_deleted, append/must_downgraded; authorization = an accepted ADR whose affects: names the requirement or its subject), Ancora.Overlap (port), Ancora.PolicyFiles (port; moduledoc defines the governance-file set explicitly: .spec/specs/**, .spec/config.yml, .spec/AGENTS.md, .spec/README.md, and what change/missing_decision fires on), Ancora.Verifier (keeper ~40%: structural target/cover/duplicate/decision-ref checks feeding spec/unknown_reference, spec/duplicate_id, spec/invalid_id, spec/missing_field, spec/requirement_unverified; all command machinery gone), Ancora.TagScanner (port incl. for-comprehension walk), Ancora.TagFindings (port; codes renamed tags/*). NOTICE entries.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.parsing.structural_references, requirement_unverified, tag_discovery, overlap_checks; ancora.gate.two_append_guards
- Behaviors to demonstrate: ancora.parsing.scenario.unknown_cover_reference, duplicate_requirement_id, requirement_without_tagged_tests, tag_inside_for_comprehension, dynamic_tag_value_recorded, duplicate_covers; ancora.gate.scenario.deleted_requirement_without_adr, downgrade_authorized_by_adr
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora from specled_ex; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale only
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: Verifier/TagScanner/AppendOnly consumed by Gate (L9); proving tests are the ported suites here
  - Fixture hygiene: tmp corpora built at runtime; no compiled fixtures
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (each append guard branch with and without ADR; ADR naming subject vs requirement)
- Call-site Integration: all six modules are consumed by Ancora.Gate in L9. Proving tests now: ported suites (TagScanner describe scoping, for-comprehensions, dynamic tags) and the append-only case matrix.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/derive/**, lib/ancora/gate*, lib/ancora/output*, lib/mix/tasks/**
- lib/ancora/{parser,schema,index,decision_parser}* (L3, read-only here)
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/{append_only,overlap,policy_files,verifier,tag_scanner,tag_findings}.ex, lib/ancora/modal_class.ex (if not landed in L2)
- test/ancora/{append_only,overlap,policy_files,verifier,tag_scanner,tag_findings}_test.exs, test/fixtures/**, test/support/**
- NOTICE
- .spec/specs/ancora.parsing.spec.md, .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no third append guard; no weakening-class enum; no change_type requirement
- no command building, execution, timeouts, forensics, or strength ladder in Verifier
- no tag enforcement toggle (tags are always on)

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora passes (from specled_ex checkout)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket

Verifier emits the structural spec/* codes with no command machinery; TagScanner walks describe/for bodies and fold_to_subjects lifts requirement ids; TagFindings uses tags/* codes with tags always on. PolicyFiles documents the governance-file set and the change/missing_decision trigger.
